cross_industry.detail: ST's fourth price-hike letter this year (dated Nov 4) is confirmed — some products rise from Jan 1, 2027, with no public details on the size or part-number list; the first three rounds took effect Apr 26, Jun 28 and Aug 23. NXP's third-round letter this year (sent Nov 2) is confirmed — some distribution and direct-supply product lines rise from Jan 1, 2027, with no disclosed size or part list; the first two rounds took effect Apr 1 and Jun 1. Renesas's Sep 9 letter also takes effect Jan 1, 2027.
cross_industry.source: limchip, Nov 11, 2026; Semiconductor Review, Nov 12, 2026; ESMC, Nov 4, 2026

cross_industry.detail: AI data centers are competing for the same cable, panel and switchgear capacity; switchgear lead times in some markets have stretched to 2–4 years, and copper cable prices are up 22%–36% year on year.

BloombergNEF's Transition Metals Outlook 2026 says copper has the most severe supply-demand imbalance: copper demand is expected to grow 61% from 2026 to 2050 to nearly 46 million tons, with shortages starting in 2028 and a 3 million-ton gap by 2035.

The minutes of the FOMC's October meeting, published Nov 18, said 'almost all' members expected a December hike, with 'a few' mentioning the possibility of more than 25bp; Waller said the same day that December should see a 50bp hike; CME FedWatch shows a December hike fully priced (25bp at 94.7%, 50bp at 5.3%), while New York Fed President Williams explicitly opposed 50bp on Nov 17.
cross_industry.source: FOMC minutes (as reported); Investing.com, citing CME, Nov 19, 2026

hotspot_events.summary: Nvidia closed at $145.98 on Nov 19 (-3.30%), its sixth straight trading day of declines, down about 16% over 5 days; on the Nov 17 earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board unanimously accepted Huang Renxun's resignation and has no intention of reinstating him as CEO, CFO Colette Kress continues as interim CEO, and a search firm has been hired to start the succession process; UBS cut its price target to $220 for the second time in three days (buy rating maintained), citing export reviews and data-center power delays.

industry_updates.detail: Vertiv launched an expanded 800VDC power portfolio on Nov 17: the new PowerDirect 9000 (for AI compute pods) and the 5MW solid-state transformer PowerNexus MV SST, forming a three-tier rack / compute-pod / data-hall architecture with the cabinet-level PowerDirect 5000 released in May; shown at SC26, with pilot projects under way.
industry_updates.title: Vertiv launches expanded 800VDC power portfolio

industry_updates.detail: Shenling Environmental won 260.97 mu of industrial land in Chencun, Shunde for RMB 234.88 million on Nov 16, and plans a total investment of RMB 2 billion in a global R&D center to build a next-generation liquid-cooling compute-infrastructure manufacturing base (R&D, validation and final assembly) — its second land purchase in Chencun this year.
industry_updates.title: Shenling Environmental spends RMB 234.88 million on land for a RMB 2 billion liquid-cooling R&D center

industry_updates.detail: Carrier launched the Carrier ClimaVision 3-MyStat Pro Pack on Nov 17, integrating the acquired 75F technology into more HVAC products; separately, the company said at a Baird conference on Nov 16 that data-center sales were about $2 billion in 2026 and about $3 billion in 2027, with orders up 350% year to date.
industry_updates.source: Carrier official website, Nov 17, 2026; Ticker Report, Nov 16, 2026

industry_updates.detail: The European Commission published the CBAM implementing regulation (EU) 2026/2498 on Nov 16, setting out the rules for recognizing carbon prices already paid in third countries (applicable to the 2026–2027 reporting period, with transitional arrangements to Sep 30, 2028); the pause on the gallium / germanium / antimony export ban to the U.S. still expires Nov 27, with no extension notice as of about 07:35 on Nov 20.

siphon_effects.detail: The four big cloud vendors' combined 2026 capex is about $730 billion (Amazon about $220 billion, Alphabet $195–205 billion, Microsoft about $170 billion, Meta about $140 billion); AWS has a $578 billion order backlog, Microsoft RPO of $677 billion and Google Cloud a $561 billion backlog, with orders booked through 2028 — yet Amazon, Alphabet and Meta have all seen free cash flow turn negative.
siphon_effects.source: Earnings-season roundup via Netcom News, Nov 17, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: Q3 global DRAM revenue was about $200 billion (+369% year on year, with bit shipments up only 4%); 16Gb DDR5 contract price is $48 (vs $8.70 in Oct 2025, up 5.5x in 11 months), and the October average contract price for generic 8Gb DDR4 was $27.5 (+5.77% month on month, a record high); TrendForce expects Q4 generic DRAM contract prices to rise another 10%–15%, with the uptrend strengthening in Q1 2027; the U.S. DRAM class action continues (the court denied the motion to dismiss on Nov 14, with responses due by Dec 7).

Samsung Electro-Mechanics held $777 million (about KRW 1 trillion) in advance payments on long-term supply contracts at the end of Q3, up 43.9% in three months from $540 million at the end of June; MLCC lines have been running at full capacity since Q3 with inventories at record lows, and TrendForce puts lead times at 40 weeks; Q3 MLCC average prices were +21.4% vs last year's average; TrendForce estimates Q4 consumer-grade X5R MLCC prices to OEM/ODM customers could rise another 25%–30% (estimate).

Shengyi's November price hikes have landed — M6 and lower-grade laminates +15% and bonding sheets (PP) +25% (the largest single-round increase in nearly two years), with production scheduling already extended to Jan 2027; Kingboard raised laminate prices for the eighth time this year (thin-cloth laminates and PP +15%); Panasonic has notified that some general multilayer-board CCL prices will rise 200% from Jan 2027 (industry media citing the letter); Panasonic's Hukou plant still has no restart news after the fire.
siphon_effects.source: FX168 / Gelonghui, Oct 28, 2026; Securities Times (citing), Nov 9, 2026

siphon_effects.detail: A Johns Hopkins University study (reported Nov 17) predicts the U.S. could face a copper shortage as early as next year: under a high-demand scenario, the transformer shortfall over the next four years is about 15% and other key grid equipment about 30%, with about two-thirds of the gap driven by data centers; a single AI facility uses 30–40 tons of copper per MW, and S&P Global expects data-center copper demand to rise from about 1.1 million tons in 2025 to about 2.5 million tons by 2040.

LME 3M broke below $3,000 on Nov 18, with the official price at $2,864/ton (-2.4%, a low for the year); the cash-to-3M premium was about $275/ton on Nov 17 (the highest since the 1988–1990 squeeze), easing to $230 on Nov 18; closed at $2,814.5 on Nov 19 (+0.90%) (fxnews.ai, Nov 19; Changjiang Nonferrous Metals, Nov 18)
